content: The major contributions of this paper are as follows: 1) To the best of our knowledge, we propose the first-ever model that tackles the sensational headline generation task with reinforcement learning techniques. 2) Without human-annotated data, we propose a distant supervision strategy to train a sensationalism scorer as a reward function.3) We propose a novel loss function, Auto-tuned Reinforcement Learning, to give dynamic weights to balance between MLE and RL. Our code will be released .
